name: ember-launch-film
description: Ember launch film — a 52s motion-graphics product launch, rendered with Remotion. Lives outside the app; borrows the app's real board engine so the handwriting is identical.

scripts.render: node scripts/make-music.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts EmberLaunch out/ember-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:vertical: node scripts/make-music.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts EmberLaunchVertical out/ember-launch-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
